column6: not an object but a bound, the ROM's last long: log_page_free_entry (0x41dce) takes an entry whose format lies past it, an erased entry's among them, as free, no text in the image lying there

the self-tests' table of checks, each a routine and its name's address, "DISP" first, which the image keeps unlabeled: selftest_print_failure reads it in place (0x28822), and the C does, so that a failure's log entry keeps the name's address in the image
the product's name in the start-up's frames, this image's "HP 58503B" (0x5ba01) where the 58503A 3704's is "HP 58503A"; the C's frames give this image's text (front_panel.c, FRONT_PANEL_SHOW)

the address field's entry of fpga_bit_table, entry 4 of this image's (0x45aaa), as it is entry 4 of the Z3816A 4001's table, which that image's names leave unlabeled (its own allowlist's 0x440b6); the C indexes its table by its own FPGA_BIT_ADDRESS

the address field's entry of fpga_bit_table, entry 4 of this image's (types/smartclock.h, fpga_bit_index) where it is entry 1 of the Z3817A 3752's five; the C indexes its table by its own FPGA_BIT_ADDRESS
